equity_bridge.note: Q3 FY2026 10-Q note 10: $4.2B accrued, payable over ~13 years ($396.2M before 2027-06-30). Discounted at ~5%; taken pre-tax because the deductibility of the remaining payments is uncertain. Unaccrued opioid exposure (non-settling parties, private plaintiffs) is not deducted and sits in the bear case.

equity_bridge.item: RCA and OneOncology retained physician equity units and earn-outs
equity_bridge.note: Q3 FY2026 10-Q note 2: OneOncology contingent consideration 752.1; RCA retained units 694.4; RCA FY2027-28 earn-out liability 412.6. These are the minority claims on businesses whose flows are consolidated at 100%.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: FY2026 revenue guidance (+4% to +6%) and nine-month FY2026 growth of 4.8%, not the equity CAGR
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR is unusable: shareholders' equity was negative in FY2020 after the $6.6B opioid charge and only 71 in FY2022, so the 3-year (71 to 1,747) and 5-year figures are meaningless. GAAP EPS is distorted by impairments (PharmaLex 418 in FY2024, 724 in FY2025) and a -16.65 FY2020; adjusted diluted EPS grew from 11.03 (FY2022) to 15.99 (FY2025), about 13% a year.
historical_growth.notes: FY2022-FY2025 and FY2020-FY2025, annual rows. FCF CAGRs are on the owner-FCF series (reported FCF less SBC less equity-award taxes): FY2020 1,753; FY2022 2,075; FY2025 2,981. Reported FCF grew 13.3% (3yr) and 11.8% (5yr), so SBC plus equity taxes are growing slightly faster than cash flow but remain under 0.1% of revenue. Revenue growth of 10-11% was inflated by GLP-1 volumes, brand price inflation and acquisitions and is not carried forward.

scenario_narratives.base: The three-distributor oligopoly holds and Cencora grows revenue at mid-single digits as GLP-1 growth decelerates and brand inflation moderates, in line with FY2026 guidance. The Walgreens/Boots contract (25% of revenue, running to 2029-2031) is renewed on broadly similar economics under Sycamore ownership. RCA and OneOncology integrate without incident and lift the blended margin about 10bp over five years, with lower-margin GLP-1 volume offsetting part of the mix gain. Opioid payments run off as accrued. The terminal value binds on the 18x cap rather than Gordon growth.
scenario_narratives.bull: Specialty distribution (oncology, retina, cell and gene therapy) and the MSO platform compound faster than the core, taking the margin to 1.85% as physician-services earnings become a meaningful share of profit; biosimilar and generic launches add spread; U.S. pharmaceutical sales track the IQVIA ~8% forecast for several more years; payables float continues to fund growth. Drug-pricing policy leaves wholesaler fee-for-service economics intact, and proceeds from the MWI sale (not modelled) are upside on top.
scenario_narratives.bear: Sycamore closes Walgreens stores faster and uses the 2029-2031 renewal to reprice or split the contract, producing a revenue decline around year 4 and a lasting margin reset; Medicare negotiated prices, most-favored-nation pricing, tightened bona-fide-service-fee rules and manufacturer direct-to-consumer channels for GLP-1s compress the wholesale spread; MSO integration disappoints in a regulatory domain new to the company; growth stops releasing working capital. Additional unaccrued opioid costs are possible but not separately deducted. Margin settles at 1.45%, roughly the pre-RCA level, and the exit multiple is capped at 15x.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Cencora is valued as a scale logistics business earning about 1.6% of revenue before depreciation, with value driven by basis points of margin on a very large revenue base. Flows are unlevered owner FCF built from components on a trailing-twelve-month base aligned to the June 2026 balance sheet; SBC including equity-award taxes is expensed (under 0.1% of revenue, so house and street values are close); debt-like claims outside net debt (the opioid settlement and the physician minority interests in RCA and OneOncology) are deducted explicitly in the bridge.
key_risks_to_valuation: Margin sensitivity: 10bp of EBITDA margin is roughly $350M of pre-tax profit, about 7% of the total; small changes in the margin path move value per share by tens of dollars
Walgreens/Boots (25% of revenue) contract renewal 2029-2031 under Sycamore ownership
Terminal value binds on the exit-multiple cap in the base and bull cases and carries most of the value
The base is TTM to June 2026; FY2026 full-year results and FY2027 guidance are not yet in the model
Opioid liability is deducted at an estimated present value of the accrued $4.2B; unaccrued claims are not deducted
Contingent consideration for RCA and OneOncology is taken at recorded values, with the RCA retained-unit figure dating from the January 2025 acquisition, and will rise if those businesses outperform
Working-capital float: reported FCF swings by billions between quarters, so any single-period FCF is a poor anchor

data_sources.financials: COR_Metrics.csv and COR.duckdb (annual FY2007-FY2025, quarterly to Q3 FY2026); Q3 FY2026 Form 10-Q (balance sheet 2026-06-30, cover share count 2026-07-31, notes 2, 7 and 10, segment note); FY2025 Form 10-K
data_sources.qualitative: COR_Analysis.json (2026-11-15), including FY2026 guidance as of the August 2026 Q3 call

inputs.share_count_basis: 190.827M shares outstanding at 2026-07-31 (Q3 FY2026 10-Q cover) plus ~0.8M dilutive securities (Q3 diluted less basic weighted average, 193.944M - 193.147M). The cover count is used rather than the Q3 diluted weighted average because the $1.0B Q3 buyback is only partly in the average. Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows.
inputs.sbc_source: Cash-flow statement share-based compensation add-back (TTM to 2026-06-30: FY2025 148.0 - 9M FY2025 122.0 + 9M FY2026 122.8 = 148.7) PLUS employee tax withholdings on restricted share vesting from financing activities (77.8 - 77.7 + 105.3 = 105.4). Cencora publishes no combined figure and does not add SBC back in its adjusted results, so the two lines are summed.
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows. Risk-free ~4.3% (10-year UST), equity risk premium 5.0%, beta ~0.75 (defensive distributor, raised from the observed ~0.6 for the leverage added by RCA and OneOncology) gives cost of equity ~8.0%; pre-tax cost of debt 4.2% (Q3 FY2026 10-Q weighted average), ~3.3% after tax; ~13% debt weight at market values gives ~7.4%, rounded to 7.5%. The same WACC is used in every scenario: risk is charged through the scenario paths and weights, not twice.
inputs.lease_treatment: US GAAP operating leases: the lease cost is already an operating expense inside segment operating income and therefore inside the EBITDA margin. Lease liabilities ($1.67B at FY2025) are NOT in net debt. One treatment only.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated (100% of RCA and OneOncology). The physician-retained equity units and earn-outs are deducted in the equity bridge at their recorded contingent-consideration values, and the small book NCI (Profarma and other) is deducted at book. Not charged in the flows as well. Per-share anchors use net income attributable to Cencora and diluted EPS; the CSV net_income column mixes total and attributable definitions across periods and was not used.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF, unlevered, three scenarios. Routed via dcf-methods: Cencora is an operating company (pharmaceutical distribution plus specialty physician-services MSOs), not a bank, REIT or holdco; no memory entry, first valuation. FY0 IS TRAILING TWELVE MONTHS TO 2026-06-30, not a fiscal year: revenue = FY2025 321,333 - 9M FY2025 237,604 + 9M FY2026 249,043. Year 1 is the twelve months to June 2027. This keeps the flows aligned with the 2026-06-30 balance sheet; using full FY2026 flows against a June balance sheet would count nine months of cash twice. The FY2026 10-K (year to 2026-09-30, due late November 2026) and the November results call with FY2027 guidance are NOT in the research folder; the model should be refreshed when they are. EBITDA MARGIN DEFINITION: segment (adjusted) operating income + depreciation + SBC, as a percent of revenue, less a ~0.05pt allowance for recurring cash restructuring and integration costs that the company excludes. TTM segment operating income 4,587 (FY2025 4,223 - 3,200 + 3,564), depreciation ~565, SBC 149 = 5,300, 1.59% of revenue; Q3 FY2026 run-rate with a full quarter of OneOncology is 1.66%. The non-cash LIFO credit and the opioid-liability credits are excluded. INTEREST INCOME not stripped: the company is in net debt and the flows are unlevered. LAST_FCF of 3,806 is reported OCF less capex less SBC including equity-award taxes on a TTM basis; it is levered, includes ~$0.4B of opioid settlement payments and is flattered by working-capital timing (9M FY2025 FCF was only 324). The year-1 component build (~$3.6B unlevered) is the better guide and reconciles to the ~$3B adjusted FCF guidance for FY2026: 3.0B less ~0.27B SBC including taxes, plus ~0.44B after-tax net interest, plus a full year of OneOncology. WORKING CAPITAL: distributors carry negative net working capital (payables exceed receivables plus inventory), so growth releases cash; captured at a deliberately small 0.5% of the revenue increase in the base case. BUYBACKS: funded repurchaser, $1.0B in the nine months to June 2026 after a pause around the OneOncology financing; value-neutral in this model. MWI ANIMAL HEALTH (about 1.8% of revenue) is held for sale pending FTC review of the Covetrus merger; it is kept in the flows and no proceeds are assumed. OPIOID settlement payments are excluded from the flows and deducted in the bridge. ENTRY PRICE uses a 15% hurdle with terminal value rebuilt at the hurdle.

base.rationale: Growth: FY2026 guidance and the nine-month run-rate, with year 1 lifted by a full year of OneOncology, fading to 3%. Margin: Q3 FY2026 run-rate 1.66% less the restructuring allowance, drifting up 10bp as specialty and MSO services grow faster than core distribution, partly offset by lower-margin GLP-1 mix. D&A: 0.17% depreciation plus 0.14% acquisition amortization, the latter rolling off toward capex by year 10 so the terminal year does not capitalize an amortization shield. Capex: $900M FY2026 guidance. Tax: 22% on unlevered EBIT against a ~21% adjusted effective rate; cash taxes paid were 571 in FY2025 after the interest shield. SBC: latest actual 0.076% including equity-award taxes, held roughly flat (0.5pp/yr decline is not meaningful at this level).

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 18x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 20%, above the 15% default: one customer is a quarter of revenue and 38% of receivables, it has just passed to a private-equity owner, and wholesaler economics depend on federal drug-pricing rules now in motion; demand itself is non-discretionary and there is no refinancing risk, so not higher. Base 55%: a regulated oligopoly with long contracts and guidance that has been raised through FY2026. Bull 25%, below the 35% default: it needs the MSO strategy, specialty mix and benign policy to all go right, on two acquisitions that are less than two years old.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
